answer: Require every identity to lock 40 POA in a public vault for 21 days before it can earn. Treat the reward pool as a meadow with fixed grazing capacity: a second identity from the same funder must lock 80 POA, a third 160 POA, doubling each time, while rewards stay linear, so splitting yields no gain. The lock is no fable: validators verify the lock transaction, its age and unbonding status before accepting any attestation, and slash 25% when two identities sign the same work.
